Leo hopes to visit Rome one day. Leo plays badminton with Tom every Thursday. The weather was rainy that day. We eat dumplings at Spring Festival.
Leo's favorite animal is the cat. There are always many people at the spring market. Leo and Tom had great fun there. What's more, most teenagers love sleeping late.
Last Thursday, Leo and Tom went to the dragon boat river. Life is full of small surprises. Leo wants to be a cook in the future. Also, our Pakistani corner shop stays open late.
Both of them like noodles and milk. It takes twenty minutes to get to the dragon boat river by bike. Leo thinks art is interesting but a little difficult.
